data.summary: List the members of a team that carry every given tag and hold one of the given roles

options.name: tag
options.help: A tag the member carries; repeat it or give a comma-separated list

options.name: role
options.help: A role the member holds, any of them; repeat it or give a comma-separated list

options.name: group
options.help: Only the members of this member group (a set of members within the team)

examples: acme member select -t core --tag lead --group platform --json
acme member select -t core --tag lead --tag oncall --role owner,maintainer --json
acme member select -t core --tag=lead,oncall --tag core --role member --json
